classification: mechanistic stress test; not a new confirmatory efficacy endpoint
purpose: Demonstrate that deadline pruning can change the minimum commit-state certificate, rather than only changing exploitability classification.
source_scenario_role: development template already present in the locked v8.0 controlled inputs
no_deadline_proxy_definition: 100 s exceeds the sum of all one-use transition durations in F5.5 and therefore includes every transition ordering the finite DCJI state graph can enumerate.
prespecified_interpretation: The short deadline tests the no-feasible-invalidating-path case.
The 5 s deadline is the constrained certificate condition.
The 100 s condition is the finite-graph no-deadline proxy.
A smaller constrained certificate demonstrates practical value of deadline pruning; this add-on is descriptive/mechanistic and does not alter locked E1-E12/E15/E16 claims.
overwrite_rule: The run script refuses to overwrite an existing E14 result file.
